title: [挑戦しよう] 在庫が予測需要を下回る商品を探す
statement:
products, inventory, forecasts から、現在在庫が今後7日間の予測需要を下回る商品を表示してください。出力する列は product_name, stock_quantity, forecast_quantity, shortage です。

forecast_date が 2026-06-01 以上 2026-06-08 未満の予測だけを対象にします。予測がない商品は forecast_quantity = 0 として扱います。shortage は forecast_quantity - stock_quantity です。shortage が大きい順、product_name の昇順で並べます。

constraints.name: 期間集計
constraints.value: 指定された7日間の予測数量だけを合計します

constraints.name: 不足判定
constraints.value: forecast_quantity が stock_quantity より大きい商品だけを表示します

starterSql:
WITH forecast_totals AS (
  SELECT
    product_id
    -- 7日間の予測数量を forecast_quantity として合計します
  FROM forecasts
  WHERE forecast_date >= '2026-06-01'
    AND forecast_date < '2026-06-08'
  GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT
  products.name AS product_name,
  CAST(inventory.stock_quantity AS INTEGER) AS stock_quantity,
  COALESCE(forecast_totals.forecast_quantity, 0) AS forecast_quantity,
  COALESCE(forecast_totals.forecast_quantity, 0) - CAST(inventory.stock_quantity AS INTEGER) AS shortage
FROM products
JOIN inventory
  ON inventory.product_id = products.id
LEFT JOIN forecast_totals
  ON forecast_totals.product_id = products.id
-- 不足している商品だけにします
ORDER BY shortage DESC, products.name ASC;
solutionSql:
WITH forecast_totals AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    SUM(CAST(quantity AS INTEGER)) AS forecast_quantity
  FROM forecasts
  WHERE forecast_date >= '2026-06-01'
    AND forecast_date < '2026-06-08'
  GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT
  products.name AS product_name,
  CAST(inventory.stock_quantity AS INTEGER) AS stock_quantity,
  COALESCE(forecast_totals.forecast_quantity, 0) AS forecast_quantity,
  COALESCE(forecast_totals.forecast_quantity, 0) - CAST(inventory.stock_quantity AS INTEGER) AS shortage
FROM products
JOIN inventory
  ON inventory.product_id = products.id
LEFT JOIN forecast_totals
  ON forecast_totals.product_id = products.id
WHERE COALESCE(forecast_totals.forecast_quantity, 0) > CAST(inventory.stock_quantity AS INTEGER)
ORDER BY shortage DESC, products.name ASC;

tests.name: 予測なしの商品は不足しない
